step_mapping_note: One simulation step is mapped to 24 hours for detector compatibility; this is an evaluation convention, not verified wall-clock time.
selection: Highest development F1; first candidate wins ties. Test labels never select parameters.
cohort: Active accounts in each interval. Positives need isFraud=1 and a known fraudStep within that interval. isFraud=0 accounts are negatives. Other positive accounts are excluded, never relabeled as normal.
scope: One external, author-generated synthetic sample. Transductive temporal evaluation; not independent account groups, repeated seeds, real fraud performance or the full banking authorization policy.
baseline_scope: Flag a source account when any outgoing transaction exceeds a development-selected threshold; simple functional reference, not a state-of-the-art fraud model.
